name: 02108 · Boston, MA
findings: ZIP 02108 (Boston) has 395 nonprofit organizations. 154 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 148 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02108 (Boston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02108 (Boston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 148 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
